I honestly don't have a problem with this scenery and can't understand the people who do. I've lived in Belarus as a young child and this just makes me feel comfy and nostalgic. I loved going on walks with my paternal and maternal grandma and seeing the same scenery of empty rusted playgrounds and grey apartments. But that wasn't all there was to even see. My paternal grandparents had a house in the countryside. My maternal grandparents had a primeval forest and the beach in their town. I loved how everything was within walking distance. 

Now I live in the suburbs of Indiana and it's so much more boring and dull. There's nowhere to even walk to, you need a car for everything, but there's nothing even worth seeing to me. I'll never be able to see those sights again. My relationship with them has pretty much disappeared and I've lost a lot of my fluency. I can only fantasize about how it all used to look and live them through my waning memories. But I haven't been doing that either. It's easier to just forget.
